Java 21; Maven 3.9+; Docker. `pom.xml` aggregates services; shared types: `ecommerce-common`.

`mvn clean package`; `mvn -pl user-service -am package`; `mvn -pl user-service spring-boot:run`; `java -jar user-service/target/user-service-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar`; `docker compose up --build`; `mvn test`; `mvn -pl order-service test`.

Tests: `<module>/src/test/java`; config: `src/main/resources/application.yml`; deployment: `Dockerfile`, `docker-compose.yml`.

Add new tests under `<module>/src/test/java`. Ensure module tests pass before merging. Do not commit secrets; prefer environment variables for credentials.
